title: Does it make the video file bigger?
instruction: You are exporting the video for the open day. What makes the file bigger and what doesn’t?

items.why: Four times as many pixels in every frame.

items.text: You rename the file to final_final.mp4
items.why: The name doesn’t change the numbers inside.
It leaves out more details, so the file will be smaller.

items.text: You film rain instead of a blank wall, for the same length of time
items.why: In rain almost every pixel changes, so compression has a lot to do.

items.text: You cut the video from a minute to half a minute
You add music to the video
items.why: Sound is numbers too, thousands for every second.

debrief: More pixels, more frames, more time and more movement mean more numbers. Compression and a shorter cut make the file smaller.
